title: KRA electronic cargo seals cease operation
detail: KRA stops operating its own RECTS electronic seals from 26 October 2026 as the multi-vendor, user-owned e-Seal framework takes over. Cargo under customs control must use seals from approved vendors.

title: ID replacement fee waiver ends
detail: Replacing a lost national ID is free until 30 October 2026.

title: Customs agent licence renewal due
detail: Licensed customs agents must submit 2027 licence renewal applications on or before 31 October 2026.

title: Bonded warehouse licence renewal
detail: Bonded warehouse, MUB and transit godown licences expire 31 Dec 2026. Renew on Customs iCMS on or before 31 Oct 2026.

title: Transit shed licence renewal
detail: Transit shed licences expire 31 Dec 2026. Applications go through Customs iCMS on or before 31 Oct 2026.

title: Marine cargo insurance mandatory
detail: KRA with the Insurance Regulatory Authority enforces mandatory Digital Marine Cargo Insurance from 1 Nov 2026.

title: KRA tax amnesty closes
detail: Penalties, interest and fines on tax debts accrued up to 31 December 2025 are waived if the principal tax is cleared by 31 December 2026.

title: KRA annual return due
detail: File your individual return on iTax by 30 June.
